summary.verdict: H0 (structure does NOT rescue zero-data): among host-homologous genes, neither pathogen pocket druggability (pooled AUROC 0.511, perm p 0.4058) nor the pathogen-vs-host difference (AUROC 0.535) meaningfully distinguishes known targets from non-targets — the information ceiling extends from SEQUENCE to STRUCTURAL selectivity (consistent with TID2, pocket druggability ≈ conservation, weak). So the 35–52% host-homologous targets E2E2 over-excludes CANNOT be cheaply rescued by zero-data structural druggability; distinguishing selectively-druggable host-homologous targets needs more than an apo predicted pocket (real ligand / induced-fit / experimental data). SCOPE: fpocket heuristic, AF apo structures, metabolic subproteome, 2 bacteria; not wet-lab.
